snippet.title: Rainbow Alterna - Overview Trailer for F3 2025 [Splatoon 3 Custom Level Pack]
snippet.description:
Introducing Rainbow Alterna, the biggest Custom Level Pack for Splatoon 3, and the sequel to the notorious Rainbow Expansion Custom Level Pack for Splatoon 2! Developed by me and Arrna (⁨@Arrna_) it's set to release this year with tons of new features that truly make it a worthy successor. Get a first look at the main highlights of the mod in this trailer, featured in Kaze Emanuar’s F3 2025 Presentation, and get ready to dive into this experience where every detail matters, but have you really seen everything yet?👀🔑 For every new update regarding the mod make sure to join the discord server, the invite is down below⬇️
-----------------------------------
Join the Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NuVYYFYYVg

Also watch the full presentation here, it’s pretty epic: https://youtu.be/pR7iSxDThXc?si=ND5eHtMXApw3O74C 👀
